title: 2025年6月六级写作：社交媒体的正确使用
prompt:
续写作文：以下列句子开头写一篇文章："As social media is used more and more extensively, there is a growing awareness of the importance of using it properly and responsibly." 可以发表评论、举例或结合个人经历展开。（150-200词）

开头句：As social media is used more and more extensively, there is a growing awareness of the importance of using it properly and responsibly.
